notes.title: Fixed bug and Update Features
notes.content:
[u][b]New[/b][/u]
- Alarm is set when the time limit is less than 5 minutes.
- More in-game sounds.
- Player notification UI.
- A new random environment.

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
- Fixed a bug where clocks sometimes don't spawn in the puzzle rooms.
- Catching a banana man doll can now increase the time.
- Fixed block object and player scaling.
